How Much Does a Massage Chair Cost?

Most massage chairs cost $800 to $12,000. Entry-level chairs run about $800 to $1,500, mid-range chairs about $1,500 to $5,000, and premium chairs $5,000 to $12,000 or more. Budget another $150 to $600 for white-glove delivery and setup, and know that out-of-warranty repairs typically cost $100 to $700.
